components.purpose: One-line notice about the new release at the very top of the page. It is a thin site-wide message bar with an optional link and dates, which suits a time-boxed launch notice.

Full-width opening banner directly below the notice. It has a heading, description, and up to two CTA buttons over a gradient or background image, and it is the only component that fits the full-width opener with two buttons.
Row of customer logos as social proof, placed after the hero.
Final 'Get started' call-to-action band at the bottom of the page, with a heading, description, and primary and secondary buttons.
